meta.title: GRN Approval Workflow: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Warehouse Manager on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that GRN Approval Workflow is absent or refused, including configuring approval thresholds for GRNs.
Repeat the same GRN Approval Workflow steps on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that the capability is available and works.
Compare the same user's workflow availability across the Growth and Enterprise plans.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Warehouse Manager on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that GRN Approval Workflow is absent or refused, including configuring approval thresholds for GRNs.; Repeat the same GRN Approval Workflow steps on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that the capability is available and works.; Compare the same user's workflow availability across the Growth and Enterprise plans.

args.need: sign in as the Warehouse Manager, test GRN Approval Workflow with value or quantity approval thresholds on both the Growth and Enterprise tenants, and compare whether the capability is absent or refused versus available

steps.note: No catalog step can access GRN Approval Workflow, represent the Warehouse Manager, configure its thresholds, or compare plan entitlements.
Confirms the session remains observable after the tester performs the unavailable workflow check, but does not assert GRN behavior.
